summary: ObjectGenome caster validation independently normalizes swivelAxis and rollAxis but does not reject linearly dependent axis pairs. A caster with rollAxis equal or antiparallel to swivelAxis therefore appears canonical to both full-genome inspect() and standalone mechanism decoding, collapsing the two intended caster degrees of freedom onto one geometric line. Recommend a bounded source-only one-shot lane that rejects collinear/near-collinear caster axis pairs without overconstraining all valid casters to exact 90-degree orthogonality, with full-inspect and standalone-decoder regressions for parallel, antiparallel, and clearly nonparallel cases.
evidence: PR #395 generation-8 exact head ebfd17e7a2d5cf2083b90e0122b70bc5c39d0962 validates caster wheelRadiusM > 0 and independently requires unit swivelAxis and unit rollAxis, but no dot/cross/linear-independence relationship check was found in the full-genome caster validation path.
The standalone canonical mechanism decoder at the same exact head likewise checks each caster axis with isCanonicalUnitAxis but does not reject equal or antiparallel axis pairs.

The office-chair-v1 fixture uses the conventional independent pair swivelAxis=(0,1,0) and rollAxis=(1,0,0); existing ObjectGenome regressions cover axis unit/shape constraints but no parallel or antiparallel caster pair rejection was found.

Deterministic repro: mutate the known office-chair-v1 caster so rollAxis=swivelAxis (and separately rollAxis=-swivelAxis); the current source paths appear to accept both because each axis remains unit length.
Repository issue/PR searches for degenerate caster, axis independence, collinear, parallel axes, swivelAxis, and rollAxis found no dedicated existing repair matching this exact invariant gap.
Source-only finding: no Roblox Studio, viewport, physics-runtime, or engine evidence is claimed.
